about.text: How well each parameter is filled within its own category. Category is joined in from bos.load's entities table, so a room's Number reads as fully filled instead of a fraction of all 30 entities, and a parameter on several categories, such as Bounds.Max, gets one row per category. Eight of the 30 entities are the categories themselves (Levels, Rooms, Walls and so on); they have no Category, so their rows are filtered out.

answer.columns: Name, Category, FillRate, Count, Distinct, ValueType
answer.title: Parameter fill rate per category
